full_prompt_en: A square surreal mixed media illustration presents a close side profile facing right, assembled from carved, metallic, and featherlike parts against a nearly black ground. A large circular spectacle surrounds the visible eye, with a thick aged gold rim and a smaller blue glasslike center. A fine horizontal gold bar crosses the frame from the left into the lens, while a second narrow ring hangs near the bridge of the projecting nose. Above the forehead, a fan of broad turquoise and slate blue feather shapes rises to the top edge; alternating dark grooves and worn bright ridges make the headpiece seem layered and old. The face itself resembles weathered bronze or carved stone, with ocher highlights on the forehead, cheek, nose, and parted lips. At the left edge, stacked rectangular ornaments, strips of ribbed material, and small bronze brackets form an intricate ear and neck apparatus. The cheek bears fine incised marks and softly mottled brown texture. The background is deep black, with only a few slight color traces, so the elaborate silhouette remains sharply legible. A warm raking light from the upper left catches the spectacle rim, the feather ridges, and the face's raised planes; recesses stay in dark teal and umber shadow. The composition is tightly cropped and deliberately flat in placement yet richly dimensional in its modeled surfaces. Its visual effect is mysterious and ceremonial, joining hand crafted ornament, mechanical circles, and organic texture into one uncanny figure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实混合媒介插画呈现朝右的近景侧脸，由雕刻、金属和羽毛般零件拼成，背景近乎全黑。一副大型圆眼镜包住可见眼睛，粗厚旧金色镜框里有较小的蓝色玻璃般中心。一条细金色横杆从左侧伸入镜圈，另一道窄圆环悬在突出鼻梁附近。额头上方，宽大的绿松石色与石板蓝羽状形体扇形展开至画面顶缘；交替的暗槽与磨亮棱线让头饰显得层层叠叠且古旧。面部本身像风化青铜或雕石，额头、面颊、鼻子和微张的嘴唇有赭金高光。左边缘，层叠矩形饰件、带肋纹的条状材料和小青铜支架组成繁密的耳部与颈部装置。面颊带细微刻痕与柔和斑驳棕色肌理。背景深黑，仅有少量微弱色痕，因此繁复剪影保持清晰。从左上掠过的暖光照亮镜框、羽状棱线和面部凸面；凹处留在深青与棕褐阴影里。构图裁切紧密，布局有意偏平，却在表面塑造上层次丰富。视觉效果神秘而带仪式感，将手工饰纹、机械圆环与有机肌理接成一个奇异形象。
style_prompt_en: Surreal mixed media illustration builds an ornate form from interlocking geometric, ribbed, and feathery components. A dark nearly black ground isolates the close composition, while warm aged gold, bronze, ocher, teal, and weathered blue describe its layered surface. Circular metallic outlines intersect straight rods and stepped rectangular accents, creating precise rhythm amid more irregular organic marks. Fine incisions, embossed edges, mottled pigment, and patinated color make the material seem handled and old. Raised planes take crisp raking highlights; narrow recesses retain deep blue green and umber shadow. The composition is tightly cropped, with one dominant curved mass and smaller repeated details packed along its edge. Even highly intricate areas remain ordered by strong silhouette and clear value contrast. The result feels ceremonial, uncanny, and tactile, combining decorative density with an almost sculptural sense of volume.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实混合媒介插画由互锁的几何、带肋纹和羽状部件构成华丽形体。近黑背景隔离紧凑构图，暖旧金、青铜、赭黄、深青与风化蓝描绘层叠表面。金属圆形轮廓与直杆、阶梯状矩形重音交错，在不规则有机痕迹之间建立精准节奏。细刻线、浮雕边缘、斑驳颜料和氧化色使材质显得经手与陈旧。凸面接住清晰的掠射高光，窄凹处保留深蓝绿和棕褐阴影。构图裁切紧密，一块主导曲面周边挤满更小的重复细节。高度繁密的区域仍由强剪影和清楚明度对比维持秩序。整体带仪式感、奇异且可触，把装饰性密度和近乎雕塑的体积感结合。
theme_en: Ornate surreal profile wearing circular spectacles and feathered headgear
theme_zh: 佩戴圆形眼镜和羽饰头冠的华丽超现实侧脸
name: Pedro Friedeberg
